paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 5.5, with a change of 2.04% from the prior close and -27.63% over a window of 22 sessions, as of September 11, 2026.

Recent SEC filings include a PX14A6G form filed on September 11, 2026, and two form 4 filings on August 27 and August 18, 2026, which are insider transaction reports, as well as a form 8-K filing on August 31, 2026, which announced the scheduling of the company's first annual meeting of stockholders.
